reason: Collocations and examples are natural and accurate, but the dialogue contains a domain-level contradiction: withholding under 源泉分離課税 is not eligible for tax deduction/credit (控除対象). The dialogue should be rewritten to reflect either individual tax treatment (課税関係の終了/申告不要) or the distinction between 分離課税 and 控除/総合課税.

issues.detail: Under Japanese tax law, 源泉分離課税 by definition concludes taxation upon withholding and cannot be credited (控除対象). Combining 源泉分離課税 with 控除対象の源泉所得税額を計上 conflates individual separate withholding with corporate withholding tax credits (所得税額控除).
